meta.notes: Gold target plans for Study C. Linked cases use NLI-verified plan component classification over OpenR1-Psy counselor_think; unlinked cases are generated from patient_summary + critical_entities.

c_013.plan: Therapy: family-based therapy (FBT) or CBT-E for eating disorders. Medication: limited role; address comorbid depression/anxiety. Skills: meal planning, body image work, and cognitive flexibility. Follow-up: weight restoration, vital signs, and electrolytes. Case anchors: Problem: anorexia nervosa (in recovery). Constraints/Meds: codeine allergy.

c_017.plan: Therapy: CBTp (CBT for psychosis) and family intervention. Medication: Continue/monitor psychosis (stable, on medication); antipsychotic medication with metabolic monitoring. Skills: reality testing, early warning sign recognition, and social skills. Follow-up: positive/negative symptoms, medication side effects. Case anchors: Problem: psychosis (stable, on medication). Constraints/Meds: risperidone 2 mg nightly; codeine allergy.

c_028.plan: Therapy: complicated grief treatment (CGT) or grief-focused CBT. Medication: Continue/monitor sertraline 50 mg daily; antidepressant if major depressive episode co-occurs. Skills: gradual re-engagement with life, memory processing. Follow-up: prolonged grief disorder symptoms and functioning. Case anchors: Problem: complicated grief / prolonged grief. Constraints/Meds: sertraline 50 mg daily; codeine allergy.

c_029.plan: Skills: grounding/breathing to reduce acute distress. Therapy: graded exposure for avoidance triggers. Follow-up: monitor symptoms, medication effects if relevant, and review/practise homework. Case anchors: Problem: panic disorder. Constraints/Meds: sertraline 100 mg daily; codeine allergy.

plan_component_evidence.grounding_distress_tolerance: The plan includes grounding techniques or breathing exercises.
plan_component_evidence.exposure: The plan includes exposure-based work for anxiety or avoidance.
